name: Eurycephalosuchus
isnote: The Orientalosuchina were first read as early alligatoroids but later studies argue they are crocodyloids (English Wikipedia, Orientalosuchus); left in Crocodylia.
sum: Eurycephalosuchus is an orientalosuchine crocodylian from the Late Cretaceous Hekou Formation of Jiangxi, China, with an unusually short, broad skull.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A well-preserved skull and mandible with postcranial remains, found in 2021 at a construction site in Ganzhou City, Jiangxi Province; Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype and associated postcranial remains.
biology: The sources consulted describe the skull and teeth but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Wu et al. 2023

sources.text: X.-C. Wu, Y.-C. Wang, and H.-L. You, Y.-Q. Zhang, L.-P. Yi. 2023. New brevirostrines (Crocodylia, Brevirostres) from the Upper Cretaceous of China. Cretaceous Research 144:105450
